grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: A Busy Week for Li Ming
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定的词数。请根据原文信息选择或填写，不要自己猜测。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
passage: Li Ming is a student in Beijing. Last week, he was very busy. On Monday, he was at school. He was in the library because he needed a book. On Tuesday, he was at home because he was sick. On Wednesday, he was at the doctor. The doctor was kind. On Thursday, he was at the park with his friend. They were happy because the weather was nice. On Friday, he was at the supermarket. He was there because he needed food. Now Li Ming is making plans. On Saturday, he is going to visit his grandmother. He is going to take a bus because her house is far. On Sunday, he is going to study English at home. He is going to read a book and listen to music. He is going to be busy again, but he is going to be happy.

questions.explanation: 原文第一句说“Last week, he was very busy.”，所以选“是的，他很忙”。
questions.evidence: Last week, he was very busy.

questions.explanation: 原文说“On Monday, he was at school.”，所以星期一他在学校。
questions.evidence: On Monday, he was at school.

questions.prompt: 星期二李明为什么在家？请用原文单词填空：He was at home because he was ______.
questions.explanation: 原文说“On Tuesday, he was at home because he was sick.”，所以填sick。
questions.evidence: On Tuesday, he was at home because he was sick.

questions.explanation: 原文说“The doctor was kind.”，kind意思是和善的，所以选“很和善”。

questions.prompt: 星期四李明和谁在公园？
questions.explanation: 原文说“On Thursday, he was at the park with his friend.”，所以他和朋友在公园。
questions.evidence: On Thursday, he was at the park with his friend.

questions.prompt: 星期五李明为什么在超市？请用原文单词填空：He was there because he needed ______.
questions.explanation: 原文说“He was there because he needed food.”，所以填food。
questions.evidence: He was there because he needed food.

questions.prompt: 星期六李明打算做什么？
questions.explanation: 原文说“On Saturday, he is going to visit his grandmother.”，所以选“看望他的奶奶”。
questions.evidence: On Saturday, he is going to visit his grandmother.

questions.prompt: 星期天李明打算在哪里学习英语？
questions.explanation: 原文说“On Sunday, he is going to study English at home.”，所以选“在家”。
questions.evidence: On Sunday, he is going to study English at home.

grammar.title: 过去时 was/were 与 be going to 计划
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was 和 were 来说过去的事情。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。我们用 be going to 来说计划。例如：I am going to visit my friend. 这里 am 跟着 I。
grammar.example: Last week, he was very busy.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：Yesterday, I ______ at home.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，过去时用 was。所以选 was。
questions.evidence: Last week, he was very busy.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：They ______ happy yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，过去时用 were。所以选 were。
questions.evidence: They were happy because the weather was nice.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：Tomorrow, she ______ going to read a book.
questions.explanation: 主语是 she，be going to 用 is。所以选 is。
questions.evidence: On Sunday, he is going to study English at home.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：We ______ going to play football tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 主语是 We，be going to 用 are。所以选 are。
questions.evidence: They were happy because the weather was nice.

part1: What did you do last week?
What are you going to do this weekend?
Are you going to study English tomorrow?
speaking.part2: Describe a busy day you had. You should say: when it was, where you were, what you did, and how you felt.
part3: Do you like to make plans?
What are you going to do next week?

transfer.writing: Write 5 sentences about your last week and your plans for next week. Use was/were and be going to. Example: Last week, I was at home. Next week, I am going to visit my friend.
